coverage_notes: All 25 modules and 256 consecutively numbered lesson headings from Section B are preserved.
Every numbered subtopic extracted from the PDF is included in the associated lesson and this map.
The 24 exercises and 10 projects in Sections C and D are represented as separate files.
Legacy practices remain in explicitly labeled maintenance lessons; they are not recommended as the default for new page layouts.
Emerging browser features are labeled as optional and require compatibility checks and fallback strategies.
